summary: Re:Zero season 2 (rows 26-50) maps cleanly and monotonically onto MF文庫J volumes 9 → 15, and ALL TWENTY-FIVE ROWS ARE ANCHORED in LN VOLUME space (T24) with no anchor-hostile row: 26 → v9 (the volume's last four printed units — this row FINISHES Arc 3, it does not open Arc 4), 27-30 → v10, 31-34 → v11, 34-37 → v12, 38-41 → v13, 42-46 → v14, 47-50 → v15, each volume completed before the next begins. The END sequence is monotone (9,10,10,10,10,11,11,11,12,12,12,12,13,13,13,13,14,14,14,14,14,15,15,15,15) and ep 50 closes on volume 15, exactly one volume below the stored ep 51 → 16 [16] fence, so no fence repair is needed. Twenty-four anchors are HIGH confidence; ep 34 is MEDIUM and is the block's one judgement call — all four wikis credit it with an opening share of volume 12 chapter 1 on top of volume 11's last two chapters, and with no page count and no teaser wording anywhere A47's hold-back does not apply, so the END advances to 12 (the mirror of wave 1's ep 54, which was HELD at 17 because only one lineage credited its share). THE 25/26 SEAM, for the w2a verdict to check against: ep 25 adapts v9 ch 4-5, so ep 26 OPENS on volume 9's 幕間『竜車でのひと時』 (p 252) and CLOSES volume 9 on 第六章『それぞれの、誓い』 (p 292) — a volume-level C1 straddle finished here, with Arc 4 and volume 10 starting at ep 27, exactly as ja-WP brackets it. ALL TWENTY-FIVE ROWS ARE CONFIRMED CANON (the stored type, now typed on sources): the title test lands on 23 of 25 rows against the PRINTED tables of contents of volumes 9-15, the licensor's own 25 synopses and en-WP's independent summaries are light-novel content throughout, there is no recap row and no 総集編 in the numbered run, and the only anime-original material any source names is a set of slivers annotated as divergence. Annotations: two real reorders (ep 30 replays v10 ch-3 scenes cut from ep 28; eps 42-46 cross-cut v14 ch 2 across four episodes and ch 5 across three), a partial for ep 34's v12 ch-1 share, a partial for v9's 断章『ナツキ・レム』 (three split-second shots only in ep 26), two abridged records for whole printed units the anime drops (v10's プロローグ『墓所』 at ep 27 and v15's closing 蛇足『――再臨』 at ep 50), a side_story for the Melonbooks short story bundled with volume 14 that ep 45 opens on, and grouped divergence / abridged records for the named additions and cuts. ONE continue point (ep 50 → 16, parity, C3: v15's 蛇足 is never animated, so the reader must be told to read it before volume 16); every other continue in the block equals its END or END+1 and is derived, not stored. NO REPAIRS: all twenty-five stored titles and air dates are confirmed on six sources and every date is a Wednesday. One premise in the ask fails and is flagged: ep 26 is NOT a double-length premiere (syobocal's nine channels all show a 30-minute slot; Bandai Channel prints 29分 against ep 27's 26分).

structure.notes:
THE INSTRUMENT AND ITS SPACE (T24). The source is the light novel 長月達平『Re:ゼロから始める異世界生活』 (KADOKAWA / MF文庫J), so end_chapter / start_chapter / volume all carry the LN VOLUME number and chapters_adapted names the units INSIDE that volume exactly as the PRINTED table of contents numbers them (序章 prologue, 第N章 ch N, 幕間 interlude, 断章 fragment, 終章 final chapter, 蛇足 the closing coda). Three other spaces exist and none of them is used for a position here: (a) the WEB NOVEL on 小説家になろう numbers Arc 4 as 第四章『永遠の契約』 parts 1-… — cited in this verdict ONLY for the author's own title strings, and it is materially a DIFFERENT TEXT for this block: ja-WP says so outright — 「本編はWeb版を加筆修正したものを収録。特に第8巻と第4章についてはWeb版から大幅に変更されている。」 (the tankōbon carry a revised, expanded Web text, and volume 8 and ARC 4 in particular were substantially changed); (b) the per-arc comicalization 『Re:ゼロから始める異世界生活 第四章 聖域と強欲の魔女』 (花鶏ハルノ, MFコミックス アライブシリーズ, 13 volumes 2020-2026) is a DOWNSTREAM licensed work — never an instrument, never a position (T24: no fake manga position); (c) the anime's own numbering.

THE ARC ↔ VOLUME MAP, VERIFIED ON FOUR LINEAGES (the ask called it a claim, not a premise — it holds, with one correction to the framing). (1) ja-Wikipedia's 章構成 brackets the arcs by volume AND by episode: 「第三章『再来の王都』（文庫第4巻 - 第9巻、アニメ第1期 第12話 - 第2期 第26話）」 and 「第四章『永遠の契約』（文庫第10巻 - 第15巻、アニメ第2期 第27話 - 第50話）」, and its 既刊一覧 table repeats it structurally (volume 10's row carries rowspan="6" 第四章, i.e. volumes 10-15). (2) KADOKAWA's own product pages label the books: volume 9 carries 「第三章、王都再来編決着――！！」 (Arc 3 CONCLUDED), volume 10 carries 「シリーズ紹介　第四章 追懐のクレマルディの聖域編」, volume 16 carries 「シリーズ紹介　第五章 決戦の水門都市プリステラ編」.
